description: 國家(自然)公園區域內公共設施─按國家公園別分 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 統計處. 國家(自然)公園區域內公共設施─按國家公園別分 （資料起始時間：86年）（其他統計期資料可使用備註網址，調整ym及ymt參數取得）. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
